THE RECOVERY PATH

Evidence. Approval. Proof.

Four specialists examine the case, but the merchant controls the correction. A grant is only the middle of the story; the protected lesson must open before recovery is verified.

  1. 01
    Find the gap

    Match the purchase to the learner and course, then read the current access record.

  2. 02
    Approve one change

    Review an exact preview before a bounded access grant.

  3. 03
    Check the outcome

    Read back the entitlement and protected lesson. Leave the case open if proof fails.
